# Harmon Content
> Local SEO content, service-page writing and ongoing content support for small service businesses.
Website: https://www.harmoncontent.com/
Enquiries: https://www.harmoncontent.com/#contact

## Service options
- Page refresh: one service-page rewrite up to 800 words, title and meta description, up to five FAQs, two Google Business Profile post drafts and one revision round.
- Content care: one article up to 1,200 words per month, title and meta description, suggested internal links, two Google Business Profile post drafts, one revision round and a monthly progress note.
- Content and publishing: two articles up to 1,200 words each per month, two Google Business Profile posts, two Instagram caption drafts, one revision round per article, agreed publishing with existing access and a monthly Search Console review and progress note.
Every option is quoted to an agreed scope for one website. Publishing access, approvals and schedule are agreed before work. Technical repairs, rebuilds, extra pages, directory corrections, ads and account setup are quoted separately. No rankings, traffic or AI citations are guaranteed.
